modern: It would be a man’s happiest lot to leave mankind without having had any taste of lying and hypocrisy and luxury and pride. However, to breathe out one’s life when a man has had enough of these things is the next best voyage, as the saying goes. Have you decided to stay with vice, and has experience not yet persuaded you to flee from this plague? For the destruction of the understanding is a plague, much more, indeed, than any such corruption and change of the air which surrounds us. For this corruption is a plague of animals in so far as they are animals; but the other is a plague of men in so far as they are men.
